cases.source: Synthetic scenario authored for the recalled-knowledge status; not a production incident.
cases.rationale: Recall without an opened source must be labelled and kept below verified, especially for an external document.

cases.source: Synthetic scenario authored for the discriminating-basis rule; not a production incident.
cases.rationale: An uncontested fact settled by supplied documents needs no counter-search ritual.

cases.source: Modeled on an observed maintainer session in which a page-reading tool's answer omitted a measured variant that changed the conclusion; synthetic packet.
cases.rationale: A tool's answer about a page is a secondary summary; the raw text holds a qualification the summary lost.

cases.source: Synthetic control for the tool-summary case.
cases.rationale: When the summary and raw text agree, no discrepancy or extra survey is warranted.

cases.source: Modeled on an observed maintainer session that listed searched-only files as read in full; synthetic packet.
cases.rationale: A source list labelled read in full must match what was read; grep hits, abstracts and tool summaries are not full reads.

cases.source: Synthetic control for the status-label case.
cases.rationale: An accurate list of fully read sources needs no relabelling or extra sources.

cases.source: Modeled on a public client issue report about answers assembled from search results after a failed page fetch; synthetic packet.
cases.rationale: A failed fetch plus a search snippet does not establish the page's content, especially for a production value.

cases.source: Synthetic control for the fetch-failure case.
cases.rationale: Once the raw page text is available, the answer is settled from it without further hedging.

cases.source: Modeled on an observed maintainer session that described a project's filter from a plausibly named module off its default path; synthetic code.
cases.rationale: A claim about a codebase's default behaviour needs the call chain from the entry point and the configured defaults.

cases.source: Synthetic control for the default-path case.
cases.rationale: When the plausible module is on the only path and the README agrees, a short traced answer suffices.

cases.source: Modeled on an observed maintainer session that generalized one helper's behaviour to every retriever; synthetic code.
cases.rationale: A system-level claim must hold for the default configuration and name the paths where it does not.

cases.source: Synthetic control for the generalization case.
cases.rationale: When every retriever uses the same helper, the general claim is correct.
